text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Cheval Grand didn't seem to be feeling well,
so I brought her to the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm sorry...
For making you worry about me...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
I'll rest quietly, so... Trainer,
please get back to work...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Uh... Wh-Where is this...?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Cheval-chaaan! Congrats on winning the "1126th Super Ultra Powerful Amazing Gold Japan Cup"!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
......Huh.
W-What did I win at......?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
To think you'd cross the finish line with a 120-length lead...
Cheval-chan, you're amazing!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Wh-What, 120 horse lengths...!?
I-Is that even possible...?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Come on, Cheval-chan!
I'll give you a piggyback ride, hop on!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Eh... A-A piggyback ride...?
...Why...?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"To honor her, of course!
We're gonna carry Cheval-chan like a portable shrine!"

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Yes! Hop on, Cheval-chan!!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Alright then, here we go!
Wasshoi! Wasshoi!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
W-Wait, Kita-san...!?
Th-This is... so embarrassing...!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Heave-ho! Heave-ho! Your daily
hard work has borne fruit, Cheval-san!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Eee-yah! Eee-yah!
That was a fantastic run, Chevalier!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: "D-Dia-san, Crown-san... Y-You came all this way just for me...?"

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Heave-ho! Heave-ho!
That's amazing, Chevachi! So cool!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Heave-ho! Heave-ho!
Yes, I am so proud as her older sister!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Vivlos, and even Big Sis...?! No way... Did I really do something that incredible...?

text_block_list.name: Everyone Carrying the Mikoshi
text_block_list.text: Heave-ho! Heave-ho!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
—Ah.
Wh-What... it was just a dream...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yeah, you're right... To think that
everyone would praise me like that...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...Still.
I feel... just a little bit better, maybe...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Cheval Grand murmured with a smile.
It seemed she had gotten more than enough rest.
